title: Pokemon TCG Pocket Cards V4 Schema

id.description: Set prefix and padded card number (e.g., "a1-001").

name.description: The printed name of the card.

rarity.description: Rarity as a run of diamond or star characters, such as a single diamond or two stars. Promo cards read "Promo".

pack.description: The name of the pack the card is pulled from, not its identifier.

health.description: Hit points as a string. Trainer cards carry an empty string, since they have none.

image.description: URL of the card artwork hosted in this repository.

fullart.description: Whether the card is a full-art print, as "Yes" or "No".

ex.description: Whether the card is a Pokemon ex, as "Yes" or "No".

artist.description: The illustrator credited on the card.

type.description: Energy type such as Water or Grass, or "Trainer" for trainer cards.
